title: Thought-Forms
author: Annie Besant and C. W. Leadbeater
description: Annie Besant and C. W. Leadbeater describe thoughts and emotions as forms perceived through their account of clairvoyant observation. This illustrated Theosophical work connects colour, shape and mental states within an esoteric model of consciousness.
editionNote: Curator-supplied PDF and EPUB from the organised ebook collection. One format was converted from the other (EPUB from PDF).
rights: Project Gutenberg (eBook #16269) lists this edition as public domain in the USA. Rights can vary by country.
